_intro: Round 3 re-renders only the types your round 2 feedback asked to change: a set note, or several fixes or notes. The same seed as round 2 gives the same room shells, so each picture is the round 2 room redone.

The cause behind most "off-centre" notes: the editor draws a floor tile half a square south-west of where the generator thought it was, and doors stood one square off the room's middle. Both are fixed at the root.
Ogre pens are on a new ogre shell, so those five rooms are new rooms, not the round 2 ones redone. EX-GARDEN-03 also moved.
BR-01's first round 3 fix was not right (you caught it): the cobble pads under the bridge ends are gone now.
chapel: Every chapel has a different altar (stone altar, saint's tomb, saint's statue, holy font, fountain); door, runner and altar on one line; the saint faces the door. Pews now face the altar (they had faced the door, in round 2 as well).
coven: Obelisks along 60% of each side wall from the altar end, not the whole wall; rows the same distance from both walls; runner centred on door and altar.
crypt: The centre tomb lies along the axis facing the door; one line of coffins each side, equally spaced; the Land of the Dead crypt on one plain floor.
mana_room: Obelisks halved (one ring under 230 tiles, two above); no free-standing crystals mid-floor, two to four in corners; mana carts kept beside the rings.
mausoleum: Centred on the room; big pieces keep a clear gap; coffins no longer overlap; small mausoleums get the same plan with statues at the tomb's ends.
shrine: The obelisk square centred on its carpet; the obelisk kept clear of the statue; a carpet only where its whole border fits.
smithy: The space behind the counter kept clear for the keeper; the forge's brick square fully bordered; fewer pieces mid-floor, more along the walls.
winch_room: Crates and barrels cut by a quarter across the set (163 to 120); every gear, winch piece and kind kept.
storeroom: No brick patch; storerooms of 100 tiles and more keep a chest on the back wall behind a crate or barrel.
cellar: Crates keep a gap from the barrel stack and from each other; kegs top up so the cellar is no emptier.
barracks: Your chest rule: six beds or fewer, a chest at every bed's foot facing away; otherwise one chest flush on a wall. Racks take at most 0.7 of a wall; hangings reach the corners.
bedroom: One bench at most, flush on a wall; a pair of chairs always has a table between them; chests on one wall share one depth.
conservatory: Benches face each other across the fountain on the long walls, or sit side by side; never one behind another.
ogre_den: Three or four more sacks and barrels in each den, heaped on a back wall.
ogre_pen: Built in the ogre keep (dungeon stone walls, ogre floor) with dark earth under the straw, tusks, a skull post, sacks, a carcass and an ogre bench.
well: Paving ends at a stone curb inside the fence, never past it; nothing in the gate's way; barrels only now and then.
graveyard: The path runs straight from the gate's middle to the mausoleum door.
shrine__ext: The aisle runs down the middle to the statue, and the statue faces the way in.
bandit_camp: Every camp has a water barrel; bedrolls in one row against the rock; the chest's back to a wall; seats kept clear of stores.
garden: The missing garden (02) is there now; the others are laid as before.
bridge: A cobble road now ends at the bridge's foot: the bank under and beside each end is earth, as on the dirt-road bridges you rated 5. The lab's cobble roads are now long enough to read as roads.
gallery: Centred on the room's own middle line, running down its length; the runner exactly on the axis with statues and torches mirrored about it; benches face the aisle.
hall: Centred on the room; benches face the aisle; an aisle of columns, statue pairs and braziers to the far end, small halls included.
throne_room: The throne on the room's middle with the door centred; the south-west side filled with statues, urns and benches.
solar: Every table set exactly centred on its carpet; nothing crowding a carpet.
great_hall: The hearth's brick laid into the room's brick border, so it reaches the wall and never clashes with it; more pieces and lights.
tavern: Solid brick behind the bar up to the bar, unblended; the bar meets the wall at both ends; four different table layouts; fuller; the bearskin kept back from the fire.
shop: Rebuilt like the armoury: the counter on a back wall with a clear walk from the door, wares along the walls, one mirrored pair of display rows in big shops, nothing loose mid-floor. Small shops may still read open in the middle.
kitchen: Stock only along the walls, in rows and heaps that keep a gap; nothing mid-floor.
